name: Lemonade Remixed
notes: Lemonade Remixed owns its release recipe (LemonadeRemixed-v...-padmint.json). The build needs no game file: an Apple Silicon Mac builds LemonadeRemixed.app with a bundled Wine, and the player chooses their own Setup.exe in the app. Releases publish the recipe only.

steps: Open {file} and move Lemonade Remixed.app to your Applications folder.
Open Lemonade Remixed and choose your own Lemonade Tycoon Deluxe installer (Setup.exe), then enter the registration name and key from its readme.txt. The game installs in about 20 seconds.
Updating? Replace the old Lemonade Remixed.app with the new one. Your saves and settings are kept.
